messages:
Alex: Quick sync — final prep for release v1.8.2 tomorrow morning. Major ask: docs site deploy and SDK docs regen need to be in the cutoff window (no more API surface changes after 10:00 UTC).
Maria: noted. changelog PR #412 is ready but needs a last-pass on the integration notes. tagging it for release branch.
Kevin: I can land the changelog once Maria approves. Reminder: bumping package.json version in api-client repo to 1.8.2 will trigger the SDK docs job.
Jen: Heads up — SDK docs regen job failed on staging earlier with the protobuf mismatch. I fixed the schema on release/v1.8.2 but we should run a quick local regen and smoke test.
Alex: Can you paste the regen command you run so I can try a dry-run?
Jen: Sure — run from repo root:
```bash
./scripts/generate-sdk-docs.sh --branch release/v1.8.2 --output /tmp/sdk-docs-v1.8.2
# then serve locally with python -m http.server 8000 in that dir
```
Maria: I skimmed the changelog. Add a short note about the console routing fallback change — customers might notice slightly different latency profiling. Put it under "Behavior changes".
Kevin: Will do. Also pinging @docs-bot to trigger the docsite CI after we merge. We should wait 15m after the last doc commit before deploy to avoid partial builds.
docs-bot: automatic note — docsite build queue length: 2. Expected start: ~00:30 UTC. Use /deploy-prod when ready.
Alex: Ok timeline:
- 09:45 UTC: last code cutoff (no API surface changes)
- 09:50 UTC: merge changelog #412 to release/v1.8.2
- 10:00 UTC: bump API client package to 1.8.2 and push tag v1.8.2
- 10:05 UTC: trigger SDK docs regen (jen to run dry-run, Kevin to monitor CI)
- 10:30 UTC: docsite deploy to prod (docs-bot /deploy-prod)
- 11:00 UTC: smoke tests and rollback window until 11:30 UTC

Maria: sounds good. I’ll do the changelog pass at 09:40 and add the console note.
Jen: I’ll run the local regen at 09:55 and post results here. If anything fails, we delay deploy by 30m.
Kevin: I’ll watch the SDK CI and ensure the generated artifacts land in the staging bucket. If the CI succeeds, I’ll run the deploy-bot command.
deploy-bot: reminder — prod deploy requires two approvals. Use :thumbsup: from Eng Releases and Docs owners.
Alex: tagging folks: @Kevin @Jen @Maria please react with :thumbsup: once your step is done so we have a visible trail.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Jen: :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup: (CI passing currently)
Alex: Great. If anything unexpected shows up during regen, post logs in this thread and add the `eng-releases` channel.
Kevin: quick note — create a rollback tag if we need to revert, e.g., v1.8.1-rollback. I’ll pre-create the docs snapshot just in case.
Alex: Perfect. I’ll be on-call for the deploy window. Thanks all.
thread_summary: Release v1.8.2 coordination: cutoff times, changelog merge, SDK docs regen commands, docsite deploy plan, approvals and rollback prep
